subject.title: [Feature]: Catch up on missed inbound messages after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel missed-inbound catch-up contract now, with Slack and Discord as the first provider-owned implementations?
rationale: Current main only has provider-specific iMessage recovery plus partial in-flight restart mitigations; a generic replay feature changes channel permissions, config defaults, ordering, and idempotency semantics.

options.title: Design provider-owned catch-up and pilot Slack/Discord
options.body: Define the SDK/channel replay contract, durable cursor/dedupe rules, and opt-in/default policy before implementing the first stable-channel catch-up paths.

options.title: Land in-flight restart recovery first
options.body: Keep this issue open but prioritize #51620, #46303, and #82572 before starting provider-history replay work.

options.title: Split into per-channel proposals
options.body: Close or narrow the generic scope only if maintainers want Slack, Discord, and other channel catch-up tracked as separate provider-owned requests.

recommendation.title: Design provider-owned catch-up and pilot Slack/Discord
recommendation.body: Define the SDK/channel replay contract, durable cursor/dedupe rules, and opt-in/default policy before implementing the first stable-channel catch-up paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses gateway restart behavior, command queues, and channel runtime contracts where recent history points to vincentkoc as the best router.
